display_long_description:
Your walls aren't as solid as you think. 

A dimensional invasion has begun — and the entry point is your own walls. BlitzGun uses Meta Quest 3 Mixed Reality technology to tear through your walls and flood your living room with enemies from chaotic parallel universes. In this room-scale arcade wave shooter, you have one mission: survive. 

[media]

🔫 9 Weapons. One Race. Every kill brings you one step closer to the next weapon. Enemies get faster and more relentless with every level. Unlock all 9 weapons, push your score to the limit — in this weapon upgrade race, the highest score wins. 

[media]

🎯 Every Shot Counts Each weapon has a limited magazine. Hit an enemy and it drains. Kill an enemy and it reloads. Fail to finish them off and your ammo runs dry — game over. Be fast. Be precise. 

🌌 Two Worlds. Two Strategies. Two different universes are waiting behind your walls: 

Artlantis — A stylized, chaotic underwater world. Short corridors, instant action, relentless pressure. 

Pinkverse — A pastel plastic universe. Long corridors give you a clear line of sight — but no time to think. 

[media]

🛠️ Technical Features

Real wall destruction — damage that adapts to your room's geometry 

Haptic feedback — every bullet, every broken wall, every kill in the palm of your hands 

72Hz+ Passthrough performance with a high-energy soundtrack 

[media]

🏆 Global Leaderboard Unlock all 9 weapons. Push your score to the top. Make your mark. 

Optimized for the full Mixed Reality experience.
